name: AgiBot
summary:
AgiBot develops embodied AI systems that combine robot hardware, intelligent control and tools for collecting and training on physical-world data. Its portfolio includes the Yuan Zheng A-series humanoids, Lingxi X-series platforms and Genie G-series robots, together with dexterous hands, teleoperation equipment and robot-management software.

The company organizes its technology around locomotion, human interaction and practical manipulation. Its Genie Studio development platform and data services support the collection and use of robot experience, while its open ecosystem includes software frameworks and datasets such as AimRT and AGIBOT World. These products serve research, industrial work and service applications rather than a single fixed robot task.
